原: Questions one to four are based on the conversation you have just heard, Question one: Why does the man think it is difficult to make the decision?
疑为: Questions one to four are based on the conversation you have just heard. Question one: Why does the man think it is difficult to make the decision?
理由: 念题套话与第一题连成一句，应在 heard 后断句；翻译分两句译。

原: Trying to recreate their designs. Would have been futile, so instead I applied my own eccentric approach.
疑为: Trying to recreate their designs would have been futile, so instead I applied my own eccentric approach.
理由: 主语 Trying… 与谓语 would have been 被句号切开；翻译按一句的意思分两行译。

原: Passage one: Pet dogs can often readily understand …
疑为: Passage one. Pet dogs can often readily understand …
理由: 篇目提示“Passage one”与正文第一句连成一句；翻译译成“第一篇短文。……”。

原: Question nine: What does the passage say about 80% of participating dogs in?
疑为: Question nine: What does the passage say about 80% of participating dogs in the study?（或去掉 in）
理由: 句末 in 后缺宾语，疑为漏听或口误；按“关于80%参与实验的狗，短文是怎么说的”译。

原: Although it might seem like time spent organizing the fridge will spoil your day. Doing so will actually make it more user-friendly, …
疑为: Although it might seem like time spent organizing the fridge will spoil your day, doing so will actually make it more user-friendly, …
理由: 让步从句与主句（第109句）被句号切开；翻译按一句的意思分两行译。

原: Often, people in hospital with. a Hip fracture develop depression, …
疑为: Often, people in hospital with a hip fracture develop depression, …
理由: with 与 a hip fracture 被句号切开，Hip 误大写；第132、133句应为一句。

原: According to Market Data enterprises. Americans spend nearly $10 billion a year on …
疑为: According to Marketdata Enterprises, Americans spend nearly $10 billion a year on …
理由: According to 短语与主句（第157句）被句号切开；机构名疑为 Marketdata Enterprises。

原: Cooks can easily do six hours of preparation for a three-hour. dinner shift, mise en place forces cooks to …
疑为: Cooks can easily do six hours of preparation for a three-hour dinner shift. Mise en place forces cooks to …
理由: a three-hour dinner shift 被句号从中间切开，句号应在 shift 之后；翻译按正确断句的意思译。
